_note: Fictional RFP. Lakeside Health Network does not exist.
pages: Lakeside Health Network is replacing its patient feedback portal.
The vendor shall support single sign-on using SAML 2.0.
The provider must enforce multi-factor authentication for administrators.
The vendor shall retain backups for at least 35 days.
The vendor must keep all patient data in Australia.
The vendor shall provide a SOC 2 Type II report.
The vendor must be certified under HITRUST.
